description: mstack enforcement. Skill content enters the conversation once and is never re-read, so anything that must hold for a whole session lives here rather than in prose.

hooks.description: Put the active item and the last checkpoint back in front of the model. Runs again on --resume, which is the case that matters: a session that resumes without its checkpoint restarts work that was already done.

The cheapest useful check and nothing more. Cheap is the design constraint: a hook that runs the test suite on every edit is a hook someone switches off. Exits 0 unconditionally; it nudges, it never blocks.

Confirm the subagent left its report on disk. A review subagent once went idle without writing one; the analysis lived only in its working context, which the parent never sees, so it would have vanished silently. A reply is not evidence, the file is.

Run the fast gate before the turn ends. Returns additionalContext rather than decision:block, which keeps the same loop protection without raising a hook error or burning the eight-consecutive-block budget.
Deny the handful of commands that are hard or impossible to walk back. Hooks are evaluated before the permission mode is consulted, so this holds even under bypassPermissions.
